<script>
// Telegram contact used on the earlier site; replace this constant if you provide a different booking chat link.
const TELEGRAM_URL = 'https://t.me/m/3KEvMv40ZGQy';
const slides = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-screen]'));
const progressButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.progress [data-go]'));
const backButton = document.getElementById('backButton');
const nextButton = document.getElementById('nextButton');
const currentPage = document.getElementById('currentPage');
let current = 0;
function showSlide(index, scroll=true){
  current = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length-1, index));
  slides.forEach((slide, i)=>{slide.hidden = i !== current; slide.setAttribute('aria-hidden', String(i !== current));});
  progressButtons.forEach((button,i)=>{if(i===current)button.setAttribute('aria-current','step');else button.removeAttribute('aria-current');});
  currentPage.textContent = String(current+1).padStart(2,'0');
  backButton.disabled = current===0;
  backButton.style.visibility = current===0 ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  nextButton.hidden = current===slides.length-1;
  nextButton.innerHTML = current===2 ? 'ПЕРЕЙТИ К ЗАЯВКЕ <span class="arrow">→</span>' : 'ДАЛЕЕ <span class="arrow">→</span>';
  if(scroll) slides[current].scrollTop=0;
  if(current !== 1){const cs=document.querySelector('.screen--case');if(cs?.classList.contains('wall-explore'))document.getElementById('exploreWall')?.click();}
}
backButton.addEventListener('click',()=>showSlide(current-1));
nextButton.addEventListener('click',()=>showSlide(current+1));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-next]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>showSlide(current+1)));
progressButtons.forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>showSlide(Number(button.dataset.go))));
document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='ArrowRight' && current<slides.length-1 && !event.target.matches('input,textarea,select'))showSlide(current+1);if(event.key==='ArrowLeft' && current>0 && !event.target.matches('input,textarea,select'))showSlide(current-1);});

// Every payment screenshot appears in one of the animated background lanes (not a stand-alone gallery).
const wallRoot = document.getElementById('incomeWallTracks');
const wallMode = document.getElementById('exploreWall');
const caseSlide = document.querySelector('.screen--case');
const RECEIPT_IMAGES=["data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,", "data:image/webp;base64,
